coordinateSystem: Blender source burger after normalization: X/Y horizontal, Z up, meters. angleDeg=atan2(y,x) modulo 360; front=270deg.
notes: Guides manually traced from cylindrical audit. Same-angle interpolation is periodic. Values describe outermost visible surfaces, not interior.
Top and bottom bun boundaries are reliable starting traces. Egg upper guide less reliable where occluded. Tomato must be texture/color/connected-seed classified rather than a uniform z slice.
All full scan exterior faces and UVs must be retained; reassignment labels must never transform vertex positions. Complete newly exposed hidden faces inward of exterior silhouette.
Manual seams are an asset-specific annotation for a generic loader; new dishes must supply their own anatomical guides. Do not hardcode these heights in viewer components.
Refinement candidate: 1 degree photometric boundaries around previous guide, ±3mm; front egg 235–305 degrees absorbs visually occluded tomato band. Inspect before adoption.
